I.A No. 6608 of 2025.
05/09.06.2025 Heard Mr. Zaid Ahmed, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Pankaj Kr.
Mishra, learned A.P.P.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 366 and 376(3) IPC as well as Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for 20 years along with a fine of Rs. 5,000/- for the offence under Section 376(3) IPC.
It has been alleged that the victim was taken on a motorcycle by the appellant and was kept at his home for 4-5 days, where she was subjected to rape.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that the medical report indicates that the age of the victim was assessed to be 18-19 years.
It has further been submitted that no sign of any physical violence was found on the person of the victim.
It has further been submitted that while having kept the victim at his house, the victim was regularly provided food by the mother of the appellant.

Learned counsel has submitted that it is indeed surprising that the victim had gone to attend a festival with her parents and relatives, but she was left alone and without knowing about the identity of the appellant, she had boarded his motorcycle.
Learned counsel adds that there has been inordinate delay in institution of the FIR.
The appellant is in custody for about 5 years.

sentences.text: Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.
It appears from the School Certificate that the victim is aged about 15 years 6 months.

It also appears that it was the appellant, who had forcibly taken the victim to his house and had subjected her to rape which is apparent from the evidence of the victim, who has been examined as P.W.1.
Regard being had to the above, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
His prayer for bail is hereby rejected at this stage.
I.A. Stands rejected.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Preet/-
